article.title: Application of other laws not barred.
article.content:
71Application of other laws not barred.

Section 71  ·  Chapter XIV  ·  page 28 of the Act
The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to, and not in derogation of, the provisions of any other law for the time being in force.
